headline: B3 Extends Trading Hours Following US Daylight Saving End
summary: Brazil's B3 stock exchange extended its trading hours for equity and derivatives markets starting Tuesday, adapting its schedule to match the end of daylight saving time in the United States.
why: Exchange schedule adjustments align local liquidity windows with global financial centers, impacting daily trading volume patterns for institutional investors.
